blocks.h2: What a Maintenance Visit Can (and Can't) Fix
blocks.intro: A maintenance visit is built around prevention, not repair. Here's where the line falls:
head: Included in a Maintenance Visit
Needs a Different Service
rows: A camera inspection to check your line's current condition
An active sewage backup. Likely fix: [Emergency Plumbing](/evanston/emergency-plumbing)
Catching early root growth or wear before it becomes a bigger problem
A cracked or collapsed pipe. Likely fix: [Sewer Repair](/evanston/sewer-repair)
A light interior clean as part of the visit
A heavy clog that needs full clearing. Likely fix: [Sewer Rodding](/evanston/sewer-rodding) or [Hydro Jetting](/evanston/hydro-jetting)
An honest assessment of what your line needs next
A line at the end of its lifespan. Likely fix: [Trenchless Sewer Repair](/evanston/trenchless-sewer-repair)
blocks.note: If your line needs more than a checkup, we'll tell you exactly what and why. No surprise upsells.

blocks.h2: Sewer Maintenance Questions From Evanston Homeowners

items.q: How often should I service my sewer line?
items.preview: Yearly if roots are a problem.
items.answer: If you've had root clogs, yearly. If not, a camera check every few years is enough.

items.preview: It helps. Protection devices do more.
items.answer: A clear line drains better. When the combined sewer is full, a backflow valve or overhead sewer is what keeps water out.

items.q: Is it better to rod or jet?
items.preview: Jetting lasts longer on grease and fine roots.
items.answer: Rodding is fine for routine root cutting. Jetting cleans the walls and usually lasts longer.

items.q: Is maintenance part of the No Drip Club?
items.preview: The club includes regular maintenance visits.
items.answer: The [No Drip Club](/no-drip-club) includes regular maintenance visits for homeowners.

items.preview: If you don't have an outside one, it helps.
items.answer: If you don't have an outside cleanout, adding one makes every future service faster and cleaner.

items.q: How much does sewer maintenance cost in Evanston?
items.preview: It depends on the service. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on whether the line needs rodding, jetting or a camera check. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
